title: Purdue Engineering faculty selected for prestigious NAE symposium
summary_en: Three Purdue Engineering faculty members have been selected by the National Academy of Engineering (NAE) to participate in the 2026 Grainger Foundation Frontiers of Engineering Symposium, one of the nation's premier programs recognizing outstanding early-career engineers.
title_cn: Purdue Engineering faculty selected for prestigious NAE symposium

title: Joint proposal including BME's Wallace wins $160-NSF grant to study musculoskeletal health
summary_en: Purdue and its partners are aiming to help improve treatment for musculoskeletal diseases, such as osteoarthritis or osteoporosis, which place a significant burden on health, quality of life and the healthcare system as a whole.
title_cn: Joint proposal including BME's Wallace wins $160-NSF grant to study musculoskeletal health

title: Purdue researchers achieve remote, autonomous power control of a research reactor in real time
summary_en: For the first time, researchers from Idaho National Laboratory, the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and Purdue University used a geographically distributed control system to remotely and automatically adjust the power of a research reactor in real time.
title_cn: Purdue researchers achieve remote, autonomous power control of a research reactor in real time
